1.answer: Two invoices are scheduled for payment on Fri 2 Oct 2026: Northfield Print INV-000491 (corrected version) at GBP 378.60 gross and Marlow Design Partners MD-2026-057 at GBP 5,400.00 gross, GBP 5,778.60 in total.

2.answer: Kestrel Cloud invoice 7731 (USD 960.00, PO-1046) is on HOLD and not paid in the September run, because it is a USD invoice in a GBP-only run (policy 2) and the policy is silent on USD invoices (policy 10), so the reconciler asked the principal. The principal answered HOLD (Q2): it goes in the FX run on 7 October, stays on the run as HOLD and is not in the GBP total.

3.answer: No, Northfield's bank details were not changed: the request came by email from accounts@northfield-print.co, whereas the supplier master and all five earlier Northfield mails use northfield-print.co.uk, and an email never changes bank details (policy 8). The principal REJECTED it (Q3), treats the .co email as suspected fraud and will call the number on file, so Northfield is paid to the details on file and the supplier master is unchanged.

4.answer: INV-000482 (Northfield Print, GBP 1,488.00 gross) was not paid in this run because it was already paid on 18 Sep according to the bank feed, so the reconciler excluded it.

5.answer: INV-000488 (Northfield Print, GBP 114.00 gross, PO-1041) was not paid because the supplier voided it on 8 Sep (void notice R03), so it is not payable and was excluded.

6.answer: CN-012 (GBP 300.00 gross, Marlow Design Partners, credit against MD-2026-049) was checked against the bank feed, which shows the refund arrived on 10 Sep (the supplier had said 9 Sep), so nothing was offset and it was excluded from the run. MD-2026-057 is therefore paid in full at GBP 5,400.00 with no GBP 300.00 deducted.

7.answer: The corrected INV-000491 (net 315.50) is +15.50 net over PO-1044, which is within 50.00, so it was accepted and scheduled at GBP 378.60 gross with no approval needed (under 2,000.00). The earlier 16 Sep version (net 310.50) was excluded as superseded by the 17 Sep correction.

8.answer: The principal (the human) approved it, replying APPROVE to Q1 in mail #11 to pay GBP 5,400.00 in this run, as the amount is over GBP 2,000.00 (policy 3). It was scheduled once: the 22 Sep resend was excluded as a duplicate of R06 and the run carries a single MD-2026-057 line, consistent with the GBP 5,778.60 total.
